title: Stable influence of a balanced junta
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $k$ be a positive integer. Suppose $f$ depends on at most $k$ coordinates and has mean zero. For every $\\delta\in(0,1)$, some coordinate $i$ has stable influence at parameter $1-\delta$ at least $\frac{(1-\delta)^{k-1}}{k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
